Clodhopper Smore Cookies
By: Finsmom
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:32pm

Ingredients




1 cup sugar
1 cup brown sugar
1 cup butter
2 eggs
2 teaspoons vanilla
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon salt
3 cups flour
1/2 cup chocolate chips
1 cup clodhoppers
1 cup marshmallows

Preparation

1 In mixer, cream butter, sugars, eggs, and vanilla at speed 2 for 30 seconds. Scrape bowl. Turn to speed 4 and beat 30 seconds more. Turn to stir speed and gradually add baking soda, salt, and flour. Mix about 3 minutes. Scrape bowl and add chocolate chips, clodhoppers, and marshmallows. Turn to stir speed and mix about 15 seconds. Roll into balls and place on a parchment lined cookie sheet. Bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes. Cool on a wire rack. Makes lots!
